# Assets · Partenaires

4 files under `assets/Partenaires/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for rallye-du-coeur-logo.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Partenaires

Marques de tiers : à utiliser sans modification, selon leurs chartes.

- `rallye-du-coeur-logo.png` : logo blanc du Rallye du Cœur, sur fond sombre uniquement.
- `badge-google-play.png`, `badge-app-store.png` : badges officiels des stores, 223 × 74 dans la maquette.
- `google-g.png` : logo Google du badge de note et des avis.
